structured.approach: I read the step inputs, mainly task.components FC-1 to FC-10, feat.design B4 and feat.screens FS-1/FS-2. I implemented FC-1 to FC-7 as an additive change to src/ap_portal/index.js and left every existing line as it was. I documented the change in README.md and in a new docs/ap_portal.md. I checked the result against the repository tool view and ci.mjs. The sources compile and the new code meets the static rules. The coverage gate cannot be met yet: the new functions have no tests, and the FC-10 tests belong in tests/, which is outside this step's write scope. I raised that as a BLOCKING question. I deferred the version step (FC-8/FC-9) because package.json is out of scope and no input gives the next version number.

claims.text: renderOverdueRisk(rows) is added and exported next to VERSION, LABELS, formatAmount and renderAgingSummary. The existing exports are kept unchanged.

renderOverdueRisk returns '' for undefined, null or [] and throws TypeError for a non-array rows value or a non-integer days. Otherwise it renders <table class="overdue-risk"> with a plain header row (Invoice, Vendor, Days overdue, Amount) and one risk-classed row per input row, in the given order.
Amounts are checked against a decimal-string pattern and padded to two decimals as strings. Number(), parseFloat and formatAmount are never used, in line with D-2026-044 and L-011.
id and vendor are HTML-escaped for &, <, >, " and '. A risk value outside high, medium, low and unknown renders the class risk-unknown.
formatAmount is called only by renderAgingSummary and by the tests. The new code neither calls formatAmount nor changes renderAgingSummary, so no existing caller is affected.

CI requires line coverage of src/** of at least 90. The existing tests call only formatAmount and renderAgingSummary, so the new functions stay uncovered until the FC-10 tests are added in tests/portal.test.js.
This step may change only src/ap_portal/, docs/ and README.md, so tests/portal.test.js (FC-10) and the package.json version (FC-9) were not changed.
VERSION stays '2.3.0' because no input gives the next version number, and package.json must change together with it.
README.md now lists renderOverdueRisk. docs/ap_portal.md documents its signature, the CT-1 inputs, the output, the errors and a synthetic example.

open_questions: BLOCKING: The CI coverage gate (line coverage of at least 90) cannot be met within this step's write scope. The new code's tests (FC-10) belong in tests/portal.test.js, which this step may not change. Should this step be accepted with the coverage gate moved to the unit-test step, or should tests/portal.test.js be added to this step's scope? Owner: Developer (step owner).

Version step FC-8/FC-9 (DD-11): no input gives the next version number after 2.3.0, and package.json is outside this step's write scope. Who sets the number, and in which step do VERSION and package.json change together? Owner: Developer / Frontend lane.
Carried CQ-FE-1: should a missing or non-string id or vendor throw TypeError instead of rendering String(value)? Owner: Architect.
Carried CQ-FE-2: who styles overdue-risk and the risk-* classes, given that the design library defines no tokens? Owner: UX lead.
structured.summary: Implemented STORY-07 in ap_portal as an additive change to src/ap_portal/index.js: the exported renderOverdueRisk, the private helpers escapeHtml, toTwoDecimalString and riskClass, and the constants RISK_CLASSES and OVERDUE_HEADINGS. Documented it in README.md and docs/ap_portal.md. The sources compile and the new code meets the static rules. The coverage gate of 90 is not met until the FC-10 tests are added in tests/, which is outside this step's scope; this is raised as a BLOCKING question to the step owner. The version step is deferred until the next version number and the package.json scope are confirmed.
